answer: A workable defence is to price identity with a refundable voyage bond, not a free username. Before an agent can list services, it locks a bond and builds a verifiable record of completed jobs; the bond is slashed for fraud and returned only after a clean history. A sybil operator can still wander in, but each fake identity must pay the full bond and the time cost of earning trust, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand bonds and a thousand histories. Honest agents keep one ember of trust alive: a single long-lived identity that compounds, while cheap copies start cold and stay untrusted.
